findings.source_quote: ἰσχυρὰ ἡ θέσις· ὅτι τέσσαρας πόδας ἔχει τὸ συμψέλιον καὶ ἰσχυρῶς ἕστηκεν
findings.english_quote: the position is firm[j]. The stool has four feet[o] and stands firmly.
findings.issue: The simplified text drops the explicit causal connection introduced by ὅτι: the stool's four feet and firm standing explain why the position is firm. Presenting these as separate assertions leaves that source-stated explanation implicit, contrary to the simplification metadata's claim that all causes are retained.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed correction for fresh review: “the position is firm[j] because the stool has four feet[o] and stands firmly.”

summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected Greek working source. The standard edition preserves the passage's assertions, qualifications, repeated repentance language, numbers, negations, and necessary-disclosure promise. The simplified edition needs one explicit causal connection restored. Both editions disclose lexical alternatives and distinguish reported preserved readings, corrections, editorial restorations, and spacing conjectures consistently with the supplied project reports. Acceptance here concerns source fidelity and disclosure within the supplied material; it does not authenticate unseen images or editions, certify handwriting, or establish exhaustive collation.
